## 30. March

Split dev dependencies into sub-groups in
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/dependencies/#dependency-groups)
and use `include-group`.

```toml
[dependency-groups]
dev = [
  { include-group = "code-quality" },
  { include-group = "tests" },
]
code-quality = ["ruff", "typos", "pre-commit"]
tests = ["pytest", "pytest-cov"]
```

```sh
uv sync --group code-quality
uv sync --only-group tests
```
